name: Gods of Giza

features.name: Clusters of three
features.description: Three or more adjacent matching symbols win on the 5×5 grid.

features.name: Countdown wilds
features.description: Each win creates a wild, some with a countdown before they leave the grid.

features.name: Up to 120 free spins
features.description: Four or more scatters award 15 spins, with more scatters adding more.

review:
An Egyptian cluster game on 5x5 where just three touching symbols make a win. Wins cascade away, and every win also creates a wild, so later wins in the same sequence get easier.

Some wilds carry a countdown that drops with each win they're part of before they vanish. Four scatters give 15 free spins, and more scatters unlock more – up to 120 in total. 96.01% RTP. Long bonuses, lots of cascading.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
